caveats:
May 20, 2019 update:
ITOS vetted and configured files and gazetteer substituted
ITOS live services added

April 26, 2019 update:
Persian feature names added.

April 19, 2019 update:
The administrative level 0 shapefile was replaced into the shapefile resource because it had been an inconsistent projection.

April 18, 2019 update:
The shapefile resource was replaced with the correct zip file.

The source document, obtained from UNCHR, contained P-codes like '20IRN031003'. These are standardized to the ‘IR031003’ format in the shapefiles and under the standard field names in the gazetteer.

notes:
Iran (Islamic Republic of) administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 31 provincen (ostān)  
- Admin 2: 429 district (baxš)  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 22 October 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 14 May 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 20 May 2019: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 20 May 2019: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-romena).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
